Acorn Rough Iron Half Surface L Cabinet Hinges

text.description_html:
Acorn RHABQ, Black Finish Half Surface L Hinge

This hinge is used where a jamb condition doesn't allow full surface application. The jamb leaf is mortised and the door leaf is surface applied. For over a half a century authenticity and function have been the way Acorn Manufacturing has produced some of the highest quality forged hardware and accessories from some of New England's finest Blacksmiths for your home and these Iron Half Surface L Hinges are forged with this in mind. The rough iron finish duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the texture of naturally weathered iron.

Features of the L Half Surface Hinge:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Length: 7"
  • Hinge portion is 3-1/2" tall
  • Overall Width: 5-1/2"
  • Leaf Width: 7/8" (width from center of pin to outside edge of surface plate).

Priced and sold as a pair. (2-hinges).
